Zusaetzlich die K3-Ausnahme: Synthetik zaehlt nicht mehr als Laengen-Konkurrent gegen eine echte SEC-Serie, und zwei nicht-excludierende Herkunfts-Lampen machen das Etikett in der Engine sichtbar.

definitionAmendmentAt120Seal.formula: 100 * winsor(latest_quarter/prior_year_quarter - 1); if unavailable and annualLegNewerYear(s) is valid, 100 * winsor(meta.annualRevNewerYear.revenue / meta.annualRevNewerYear.priorRevenue - 1); otherwise 100 * winsor(annualRev[0]/annualRev[1] - 1)
definitionAmendmentAt120Seal.validity: annualLegNewerYear(s): record present with a string end, stored annualRev[0] > 0 and exactly equal to priorStored, revenue > 0, priorRevenue > 0.
definitionAmendmentAt120Seal.missing: Quarterly leg drops as before. With a valid record the annual fallback is the record ratio (annualRev[1] is then not required); without it the annual fallback requires two adjacent finite years and a positive denominator; otherwise null.
definitionAmendmentAt120Seal.inherits: ruleOfX ("same period selection as revGrowthLevel") and the growth factor (revYoYComponents: the annual component is the record ratio only when no quarterly component exists) inherit the amendment.
definitionAmendmentAt120Seal.traceBuilder: scripts/gqs00-freeze.js periodSelection.annualYoYRaw uses axesFns.revAnnualLegYoY (record-aware); golden fixtures carry no record, the 1.1.0 traces rebuild byte-identically.
